items.title: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF files for 3-for-1 forward share split
items.snippet: At the close of trading on Sept. 28, shareholders will receive two extra shares for each one they hold.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Anthropic tabs Accenture as embedded evaluator to help with AI slowdown proposal
items.snippet: The partnership is non-exclusive, and Anthropic expects to announce other evaluators in forthcoming weeks with which it will also work.
items.note: Позитивний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами.
